He writes about a wide range of subjects from hi-tech to the web to sports.', 'Czech News Center | Czech News Center a.s. (previously known as Ringier Axel Springer CZ a.s.) is one of the largest media houses in the Czech Republic. The sole owner of the company is Czech Media Invest a.s., which is indirectly owned by Daniel Křetínský and Patrik Tkáč.']

These movements are one of the reasons for the time lag in the ink jet printing.', 'Ink ball | An ink ball, inking ball, or dabber was a tool used in printmaking and letterpress printing to apply ink to the plate or type to be printed.']
